name: Zimri
overview: The name Zimri appears in Scripture referring to multiple individuals, each illustrating different facets of Israel's history. One Zimri, a prince of the Simeonites and son of Salu, was involved in a grievous sin that provoked God’s judgment, as seen when he was slain with a Midianitish woman during Israel’s wilderness period (Numbers 25:6-8,14). Another Zimri was a servant and military captain who seized the throne of Israel by killing King Elah, demonstrating the instability and moral decline in Israel’s monarchy (1 Kings 16:9-10). These accounts highlight the consequences of rebellion and unfaithfulness in God’s people and underscore the need for Christ’s redemptive work to restore true leadership and holiness.
